    tsdst.tmath.mann_whitney¶

    tsdst.tmath.mann_whitney(x, y, y_is='groups')[source]¶

    Mann-Whitney sum-rank test.

    Parameters:
    xnumpy array

    Values to be evaluated. Either a single group, or an array containing both group values if y_is == ‘groups’

    ynumpy array

    Values to be evaluated against x, or, if y_is == ‘groups’, then y is a boolean value indicating which group the values of x belong to.

    y_isbool, optional

    Whether or not y is itself a group of values, or an indicator variable for identifying the groups within x. The default is ‘groups’.

    Returns:
    resdict

    The results of the Mann-Whitney test.
